summary: Iteration 8 verified the AssignFeeDialog stale-collection-months bug fix (removal of monthsHydratedRef). Backend: NEW pytest test_class_viii_may_june_skip_march_charge.py PASSED — POST /api/fees/plans with 37000/monthly + month_amounts [May=0, June=0, March=3700] returns installments endpoint result: May skip/0, June skip/0, March active/3700, other 9 months active/3700, total ₹37,000. Existing test_fee_plan_month_overrides.py 4/4 PASS. FRONTEND (primary bug reproduction): Opened existing plan-based fee assignment for real-seed Class VIII student Aarav Jangid (KNP-937, id 5df9ed17) whose saved assignment carries the STALE default collection_months [4,5,7,8,9,10,11,12,1,2] (May charged, June skipped, March missing) — the exact bug trigger. The plan '8th demo' (live, class VIII, ₹37,000, month_amounts May=0/June=0/March=3700/July=3700) is active. Dialog now correctly renders: April ₹2850 active, MAY = No Fee ✅ (previously incorrectly charged), JUNE = No Fee (Summer Vacation) ✅, July–Feb ₹2850 active, MARCH ₹2850 active ✅ (previously missing). Fee Summary shows Collection Months: April – March (No Fee in May & June) — synced with the plan (NOT the stale 'April – February / No Fee in June & March'). Sum of 10 active installments = ₹28,500 = Net Payable exactly (Gross ₹37,000 − Concession ₹8,500). Concession scaling factor 28500/37000 applied uniformly. No console errors referring to monthsHydratedRef; symbol fully removed from AssignFeeDialog.jsx. Backend confirms _sync_plan_assignments propagates plan edits (assignment still had stale collection_months on GET /api/fees/assignments, but frontend now overrides at display time from GET /api/fees/plans/{id}/installments — this is the fix).

Real-seed Class VIII students still carry stale collection_months on the assignment document — the frontend fix masks this via display-time re-sync from GET /api/fees/plans/{id}/installments.
rca of the issue: Iteration 7 first sync fix added a monthsHydratedRef guard that ran ONCE on dialog open and hydrated collectionMonths from the assignment's saved collection_months. Real-seed assignments carry the pre-override default [4,5,7,8,9,10,11,12,1,2] (May charged, June skipped, March missing). Because the guard blocked subsequent syncs, the dialog kept that stale list even after switching to plan mode; the plan-mode rebuild then computed a 'typical' monthly amount and charged May while dropping March. Fix (verified): remove monthsHydratedRef entirely — the plan-timeline fetch effect now ALWAYS setCollectionMonths from the plan's /installments rows in plan mode. Verified end-to-end: dialog shows May/June No Fee and March charged with sum = Net Payable.
